svg.font-family: Latin Modern Roman, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
svg.text: Training-time forward + backward path. Encoder / decoder are neural (backprop); the RQ module is a non-differentiable nearest-code lookup trained by a side channel.
Residual Quantization module (RQ, depth D) — non-differentiable nearest-code lookup

g.text: Semantic ID = ( c1, c2, ... , cD ) + collision-breaker token
the stacked discrete codes — this tuple is the item's "token sequence"
frozen after training: no gradient path through argmin, so downstream models cannot change the assignment
trains codebook entries (often EMA instead of gradient)
lets encoder train despite the non-diff step

svg.text: Architecture: Lee et al. 2022 (Kakao Brain / POSTECH), "Autoregressive Image Generation using Residual Quantization" — RQ-VAE + RQ-Transformer.
Semantic-ID application to recommenders: Rajput et al. 2023 (Google), TIGER — "Recommender Systems with Generative Retrieval". Diagram shows the item-embedding (MLP) variant.
